Create ONE charming little medieval fantasy game-piece warrior with a BIG HELMET/HEAD and short stocky body (about THREE HEADS TALL), round chunky forms, oversized mitt-like gloves and boots, a gentle jaunty upright pose. Keep the equipment recognisable but translate EVERY element into simple ROUND, FRIENDLY, PLAYFUL exaggerated icon forms. Small gentle comedic pomp is welcome. Complete tiny character from helmet to both boots, all weapon tips and accessories inside with 8% clear margin; Cabrant with whole horse and all four hooves. TRUE transparent PNG background and open gaps, NO paper, scene, ground, outer shadow, glow, haze, lettering or frame.
